name: Parameterized Occupancy Fields
definition: A transformation function that contracts an infinite 3D space into a limited occupancy field to handle unbounded scenes, preserving high resolution for an inner region of interest (ROI) and scaling point distribution inversely with distance in the outer region to reduce memory consumption.
summary: Parameterized Occupancy Fields is a coordinate transformation method that contracts infinite 3D space into a bounded field for LiDAR-free occupancy prediction, preserving high resolution in an inner region while reducing memory in the outer region.
